adjudication_ja: Both reviews agree on 10/12 item recall and 1/3 critical evidence. For order, final follows the strict convention used in earlier DNS cases: explorer.exe -> cmd.exe parent launch and cmd.exe /c batch execution are collapsed into one candidate step, so C25-S01 -> C25-S02 is not credited. C25-S02 -> C25-S03 is credited because candidate places inferred tshark.exe after the batch execution.
